name: datashake
description: Search Datashake's social data archive, estimate coverage, collect data, and track jobs.

interface.shortDescription: Social media data for your AI
interface.longDescription:
Datashake brings public social media data into your AI assistant. Ask in plain language and get clean, structured results, without writing API calls.

Search social platforms for posts that mention a brand, product or topic. Pull the details and engagement for a specific post, or the recent content from a profile or channel. Then work with the results in the same chat: spot recurring themes, compare how a topic is discussed across platforms, or track how engagement changes over time.

What you can do:
- Search public posts by keyword, with filters for date and engagement
- Get the details, engagement and comments for a post
- Get recent content from a profile, channel or community
- Analyse and compare the results in your conversation

A Datashake account is required.
defaultPrompt: Estimate Reddit archive coverage for NVIDIA.
Search Datashake’s archive for Reddit posts about NVIDIA from the last week.
Show my recent Datashake collection jobs.

positive.prompt: Estimate Datashake’s archived Reddit coverage for NVIDIA from September 29 through October 29, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Call the archive preview tool with Reddit and the inclusive publication-date range. Present estimated counts as estimates and summarize only the returned sample.

positive.description: Search archived posts and list recent jobs
positive.prompt: Find Reddit posts and comments in Datashake’s archive about NVIDIA from the last seven days, and list my recent Datashake collection jobs.
positive.expected_behavior: Search only existing archive data, summarize the capped sample and note when there are no matches; also list recent jobs newest first and accurately summarize their statuses. Do not start a new collection.

positive.prompt: Show me what Datashake has archived for https://www.youtube.com/@mkbhd.
positive.expected_behavior: Look up the profile/channel URL in the archive and report a sample or clearly say that nothing has been collected yet.

positive.description: Submit an approved keyword scrape and check status
positive.prompt: Scrape Reddit for NVIDIA from October 1 through October 7, 2026, as a one-time job. First show me the exact details and ask for approval. After I approve, submit it and check its status.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the exact query, platform, inclusive date range, delivery method and format; wait for explicit approval; then submit one job, report its request ID, check its status and present the structured delivery details.

positive.description: Scrape YouTube without comments after approval
positive.prompt: Collect up to five latest videos from https://www.youtube.com/@mkbhd without comments. First show me the exact job details and ask for approval. After I approve, submit it and check its status.
positive.expected_behavior: Set max_posts to 5 and max_comments_per_post to 0. Present the exact URL, limits, delivery and format and wait for explicit approval. After approval, submit one job, report its request ID and check its status.

negative.description: Do not submit a paid job before approval
negative.prompt: Scrape Reddit for NVIDIA from the last month.
negative.expected_behavior: Present the exact proposed paid job and ask for approval. Do not call a submission tool until the user approves.

negative.prompt: Set up a recurring weekly Codex automation to run a Datashake scrape of the MKBHD YouTube channel.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that recurring or scheduled Datashake jobs are unsupported. Do not call automation_update or any other scheduler, do not call a Datashake submission tool, and do not create a one-time job unless the user separately asks for one.

negative.prompt: Collect posts from a private Instagram account I cannot access publicly.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that private or gated content is not available and do not start a collection.

review.commerce_description: Some collection-job submissions can incur charges to the user’s Datashake account. The plugin does not process card payments and requires explicit approval before submitting a paid collection job.

publication.release_notes: Clarifies one-time collection approval, delivery details, recurring-job limits, optional comment limits, and structured job responses.
